author: holidaygirl1225
quote:
Not gonna lie, this game literally looks like the Saints Row reboot and Cyberpunk 2077 fused together into a Sims game. If I wanted to play anyone of those games, I would play them. I might add, I've seen the one-sided beef the GTA fans have with the Zelda fans, it's funny as hell.
The interactions in the game's world is interesting thoug, but not interesting enough for me to buy a PS5 or Xbox and then spend an extra 80 bucks on a single game, I most likely could get a used PS3 and a used copy of GTA 5 on eBay for much cheaper, I actually enjoyed that game despite never having the chance of playing it, that's how impactful GTA 5 is.

Goodbye and have a good day sir or madam.

author: holidaygirl1225
quote: I never understood the hype around the original version of the game, I always thought for a while that the game was being glazed the way it was because it was the first ever 3D Zelda, in fact I preferred its sister title because of that thought process, and I still love Majora's Mask of course, but this remake has made me realize why this title is adored by millions!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
